name: shell
title: Section Shell
author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
description: Container, Section, Grain and the one stylesheet the page's marquees and responsive collapses read from. Every section item depends on this: it owns the 1280 container, the three grounds, the marquee keyframes and the reduced-motion stop that Tailwind cannot express.
docs: Grain reads its texture from --jh-grain, which this file does not define because the SVG is a project asset. Set it beside your palette: :root { --jh-grain: url('/assets/grain.svg'); }. Unset, Grain renders nothing.
